info.title: webitel-dcctl API
info.description: Datacenter switching for Webitel. Errors are `Error` objects; tell them apart by `id`, not by the HTTP status.

tags.name: ArbiterService
tags.description:
Storage of the arbiter voter, served by `webitel-dcctl arbiter` over gRPC
with mTLS only.

An arbiter without `records/state` is uninitialized. Until a dcctl
instance creates `records/state` with allow_missing, every other call
fails with FAILED_PRECONDITION, reason ARBITER_UNINITIALIZED.
